title: Private Hope collection snapshot shape v0.1
description: Sensitive plaintext storage interchange, not diagnostics or public export. Structural schema only; semantic decoder invariants are specified in ce-w04-a19-hope-collection.md.

counter.description: Canonical decimal u64. Decoder must also enforce the numeric upper bound 18446744073709551615.

captureTime.description: The runtime enforces its Gregorian date/time profile; format validation must be enabled by consumers.

reflectionJson.description: Exact canonical hope.reflection.v0.1 payload. Decoder must parse and validate it and compare its ID/time with the entry.
